verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity is driven through a secret-key REST API: sessions are created via curl, results are retrieved programmatically, and webhooks trigger automated reactions. Stripe also documents an official CLI and an MCP server, so the integration side runs headlessly without a dashboard. The ID capture itself still needs an end user. Missing for 10: CI-specific guidance (e.g., test-mode or simulated verification outcomes for pipelines), Identity-specific CLI usage evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI automation.
